title: Uprooter of Mountains
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Rabbi Meir and Resh Lakish were called by this honored title. [Sanhedrin 24a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.24a.7-8) says, “One who sees Rabbi Meir in the study hall sees him as though uprooting mountains upon mountains,” and “One who sees Resh Lakish in the study hall sees him as though uprooting mountains and grinding them against one another.” Rabbah, too, was called an uprooter of mountains at [the end of Horayot (14a)](https://www.sefaria.org/Horayot.14a.4).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Sanhedrin gives Ulla’s description of Resh Lakish and Ravina’s description of Rabbi Meir. The linked Horayot explicitly contrasts Rabbah, an “uprooter of mountains,” with Rav Yosef, “Sinai.” [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2873&lang=en) directs this headword to Rabbah.
